channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Zeljko Obradovic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Zeljko Obradovic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Zeljko Obradovic, Igor Kokoskov
item.description:
“I don’t watch a lot of seminars, but I like to look them up. I was watching Obradovic and a couple of other coaches, such as Dusan Alimpijevic, who’s now coaching Besiktas. I watched Igor Kokoskov, who is in Atlanta now. I watched a couple of seminars. If you want to be good, you need to be a fanatic in basketball; that needs to be your life, and I like to see something different; why not?”

Nikola Jokic on Zeljko Obradovic, Igor Kokoskov, Oct 7, 2023. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Derrick Williams on Zeljko Obradovic
item.description:
Williams tried to imagine Zeljko's and LeBron's duo in the NBA.

“Obradovic is so detailed about the game. Offense, and defense, we were always constantly studying the game and film. The film does a lot. Regardless it's good or bad, I think you can always learn from the film,”

Derrick Williams on Zeljko Obradovic, Dec 8, 2022. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Zeljko Obradovic, Yam Madar
item.description:
Boston’s main focus was on Yam Madar who was Boston’s 47th pick in 2020.

“Madar has done a great job and is in a good position. As a young player, he has a chance to play for Partizan, under Zeljko Obradovic, which is a really big thing for him. I believe he’s using it the best way,”

Brad Stevens on Zeljko Obradovic, Yam Madar, Dec 12, 2021. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Dusan Ivkovic on Zeljko Obradovic
item.description:
For Serbian basketball great Dusan Ivkovic, his longtime friend and former coaching partner on the national team, the only thing that can seriously motivate Obradovic is the prospect of coaching an NBA team.

“You see, I coached Zeljko and he was my assistant, we are family friends, so I can say that I know him very well. According to this, I can also express the opinion that one real and great motivation for Zeljko to continue to work as a coach in his stable and mature years, would be to go to the NBA,”

Dusan Ivkovic on Zeljko Obradovic, Oct 11, 2020. Source: EuroHoops.net.
